items.label: ✦Design
items.value: Tshirts for women with curved hem, v neck and loose fit. It's flattering and flowy to hide the stomach which suitable for any body shape, available in floral and solid colors

items.label: ✦Match
items.value: The versatile tshirt pairs perfectly with jeans, shorts, slacks, skirts, bike shorts & leggings. The curved hem adds a stylish touch, long enough to cover the hip and rear, making it perfect to wear with leggings. Wear it alone or as a layered look with cardigans in the cooler weather.

items.label: ✦Clothing Care
items.value: Machine or Hand Wash with Cold Water/Hang or Line Dry/No Bleach. Note: As the long-distance transportation, the tanks may be squeezed in the packaging, it's will look great after iron.

items.label: ✦Occasion
items.value: Daily Casual/ Around home/ Work/ Beach/ Vacation/ OOTD/ Errands/ Going out/ Workout, etc. Especially suitable for travels in tropics.
